final: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM line) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total_above, SUM(n) AS total_expenses, AVG(total - (SELECT a FROM avg_t)) AS avg_excess FROM line WHERE total > (SELECT a FROM avg_t)
